payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition and explanation of Masked Document Generation (MDG) as a task in the context of seq2seq Transformer pre-training for document summarization.

claims.text: Masked Document Generation (MDG) is a task that learns to recover a document with a masked span of tokens.
MDG involves masking a continuous sub-sequence of a document and predicting the original text without using [MASK] tokens for every token.
MDG is one of three pre-training tasks designed to improve the performance of seq2seq models in abstractive summarization.
